sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. Preserve the prior relationship, applicability, alternative, attachment, side-count, and thickness instructions. Correct TRF049FrameAttachmentShape: nltl:frameAttachment is an ObjectProperty, not the attachment-node class; use the supplied canonical nltl:frameAttachmentRecord class. Also attach the currently unused TRF049FrameWebThicknessShape to every applicable in-area frame through nltl:frameWebThickness with the required cardinality, so the frame web quantity is actually validated as a millimetre quantity and is available to the bracketThickness >= frameWebThickness comparison.
